items.source:
Execute a handshake request to the given url and handle the resulting
WebSocket session with the given handler.
items.translation: 向给定的 URL 执行握手请求，并使用给定的处理器处理生成的 WebSocket 会话。

items.source: If the list includes an XhrTransport (or more specifically an implementation of InfoReceiver) the instance is used to initialize the infoReceiver property, or otherwise is defaulted to RestTemplateXhrTransport.
items.translation: 如果列表中包含一个 `XhrTransport`（更具体地说是 `InfoReceiver` 的实现），则该实例用于初始化 `infoReceiver` 属性；否则，默认值为 `RestTemplateXhrTransport`。

items.source: If the list of transports provided to the constructor contained an XhrTransport or an implementation of InfoReceiver that instance would have been used to initialize this property, or otherwise it defaults to RestTemplateXhrTransport.
items.translation: 如果提供给构造器的传输列表中包含一个 `XhrTransport` 或一个会用于初始化此属性的 `InfoReceiver` 实现，否则默认值为 `RestTemplateXhrTransport`。

items.source: Implements Lifecycle in order to propagate lifecycle events to the transports it is configured with.
items.translation: 实现Lifecycle接口，以便将生命周期事件传播到其配置的传输层。

items.source: By default Jackson2SockJsMessageCodec is used if Jackson is on the classpath.
items.translation: 默认情况下，如果 Jackson 在类路径中，则使用 Jackson2SockJsMessageCodec。

items.source: The default implementation builds a SockJsUrlInfo which calculates a random server id and session id if necessary.
items.translation: 默认实现会构建一个 `<code>SockJsUrlInfo`，在必要时计算随机服务器 ID 和会话 ID。

items.source: By default this method returns null.
items.translation: 默认情况下，此方法返回null。

items.source:
By default if this property is not set, all handshake headers are also
used for other HTTP requests. Set it if you want only a subset of handshake
headers (for example, auth headers) to be used for other HTTP requests.
items.translation: 默认情况下，如果未设置此属性，所有握手标头也将用于其他 HTTP 请求。如果您只想让一部分握手标头（例如认证标头）用于其他 HTTP 请求，请设置此属性。

items.source: By default this is not configured in which case a fallback may take longer.
items.translation: 默认情况下未配置此选项，此时回退操作可能需要更长时间。

items.source: Create a new SockJsUrlInfo for the current client execution.
items.translation: 为当前客户端执行创建一个新的SockJsUrlInfo。

items.source: Return the configured InfoReceiver (never null).
items.translation: 返回配置的InfoReceiver（永远不会为null）。

items.source: Return the user to associate with the SockJS session and make available via WebSocketSession.getPrincipal().
items.translation: 将用户返回并关联到 SockJS 会话，并通过 WebSocketSession.getPrincipal() 使其可用。

items.source: The names of HTTP headers that should be copied from the handshake headers of each call to execute(WebSocketHandler, WebSocketHttpHeaders, URI) and also used with other HTTP requests issued as part of that SockJS connection, for example, the initial info request, XHR send or receive requests.
items.translation: 应从每次调用 execute(WebSocketHandler, WebSocketHttpHeaders, URI) 的握手头中复制，并用于该 SockJS 连接期间发出的其他 HTTP 请求（例如初始 info 请求、XHR 发送或接收请求）的 HTTP 头名称。

items.source:
The configured HTTP header names to be copied from the handshake
headers and also included in other HTTP requests.
items.translation: 要复制自握手标头并包含在其他 HTTP 请求中的配置 HTTP 标头名称。

items.source: Return the SockJsMessageCodec to use.
items.translation: 返回要使用的 SockJsMessageCodec。

items.source:
By default, the result of a SockJS "Info" request, including whether the
server has WebSocket disabled and how long the request took (used for
calculating transport timeout time) is cached. This method can be used to
clear that cache hence causing it to re-populate.
items.translation: 默认情况下，SockJS“Info"请求的结果（包括服务器是否禁用了 WebSocket 以及请求耗时（用于计算传输超时时间））会被缓存。此方法可用于清除该缓存，从而导致其重新填充。

items.source: In the case of a container, this will return true only if all components that apply are currently running.
items.translation: 对于容器而言，仅当所有适用的组件当前都在运行时，此方法才返回 `true`。

items.source: Note that this stop notification is not guaranteed to come before destruction: On regular shutdown, Lifecycle beans will first receive a stop notification before the general destruction callbacks are being propagated; however, on hot refresh during a context's lifetime or on aborted refresh attempts, a given bean's destroy method will be called without any consideration of stop signals upfront.
items.translation: 请注意，此停止通知并不保证在销毁之前发出： 在常规关闭过程中，Lifecycle 圈会先接收停止通知，然后再传播通用的销毁回调；然而，在上下文生命周期期间的热刷新或中止的刷新尝试中，给定 bean 的销毁方法将在不考虑任何预先停止信号的情况下被调用。

items.source: Should not throw an exception if the component is already running.
items.translation: 如果组件已经在运行，则不应抛出异常。

items.source:
In the case of a container, this will propagate a hard start signal to all
components that apply, even to non-auto-startup components.
items.translation: 对于容器而言，这将向所有适用的组件传播硬启动信号，即使包括非自动启动的组件。

items.source: Should not throw an exception if the component is not running (not started yet).
items.translation: 如果组件尚未运行（尚未启动），则不应抛出异常。

items.source:
In the case of a container, this will propagate the stop signal to all components
that apply.
items.translation: 对于容器，这将向所有适用的组件传播停止信号。

items.source: Configure a TaskScheduler for scheduling a connect timeout task where the timeout value is calculated based on the duration of the initial SockJS "Info" request.
items.translation: 配置一个 `TaskScheduler` 以调度连接超时任务，其中超时值基于初始 SockJS“Info”请求的持续时间计算得出。

items.source: Configure the InfoReceiver to use to perform the SockJS "Info" request before the SockJS session starts.
items.translation: 配置在 SockJS 会话开始之前用于执行 SockJS“Info”请求的InfoReceiver。
